questions.question: What's included in the Nano plan (₹5,000/month)?
questions.answer: The Nano plan is perfect for aspiring founders and solopreneurs. It includes a one-time logo design with basic brand stationery (letterhead, visiting cards, envelope, 4-page brochure), a static 5-page website, domain & hosting setup, quarterly SEO check-ins, and annual strategy consultation. Print packages are available in Bharat only.

questions.question: What's the difference between Starter and Growth plans?
questions.answer: The Starter plan (₹25,000/month) includes premium branding, a 5-page business website, social media management for 2 platforms, 4 blog posts per month, and basic SEO. The Growth plan (₹75,000/month) offers premium brand guidelines, up to 10-page website, 4-platform social media, 8 blog posts + 2 infographics monthly, advanced SEO (on-page + off-page), Google & Facebook Ads management, and a dedicated account manager. Growth is ideal for mid-market businesses ready to scale.

questions.question: What makes the Enterprise plan different?
questions.answer: The Enterprise plan (₹200,000/month) provides a full-stack digital partnership with custom brand identity, unlimited-page website, comprehensive SEO + technical SEO, full-scale social media across all platforms, custom content strategy (blogs, video, infographics), PPC management with large ad budgets, influencer marketing, reputation management, custom AI/automation solutions, weekly performance reviews, and a dedicated strategist + account team with 24/7 priority support.

questions.question: Are one-time features separate from monthly services?
questions.answer: Yes. Each plan includes one-time setup deliverables (logo design, brand stationery, website, domain setup) that are completed at the start. Monthly recurring services (SEO, social media, content creation, analytics, support) continue for the duration of your plan. The note 'Branding is a one-time deliverable; all other items are recurring monthly services' applies to all tiers.

questions.question: Do you offer yearly pricing discounts?
questions.answer: Yes! All plans offer yearly pricing that saves you 2 months. For example, Nano is ₹50,000/year (save ₹10,000 vs monthly), Starter is ₹250,000/year (save ₹50,000), Growth is ₹750,000/year (save ₹150,000), and Enterprise is ₹2,000,000/year (save ₹400,000). You can toggle between monthly and yearly pricing on our pricing page.

questions.question: Can I hire you for a specific service without a monthly plan?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We offer project-based and workshop-based pricing for individual services. Strategy & Innovation starts at ₹50,000 per project, Digital Transformation at ₹75,000 per project, Capability Building workshops at ₹20,000 per session, Design Thinking Workshops at ₹25,000 (half-day) to ₹50,000 (full-day), and IT Management Solutions with custom project pricing. Contact us for a detailed quote.

questions.question: What does Strategic Digital Marketing include?
questions.answer: Our Strategic Digital Marketing service includes SEO Optimization (₹12,000/month), Social Media Management (₹8,000/month), Content Marketing (₹5,000/month), Paid Advertising/PPC (₹10,000/month), Email Marketing (₹5,000/month), and Analytics & KPIs (₹10,000/month). These can be purchased individually or as part of our tiered packages for better value.

questions.question: How much do Design Thinking Workshops cost?
questions.answer: We offer three workshop formats: Half-Day Workshop (3-4 hours) starting at ₹25,000, Full-Day Workshop (6-8 hours) at ₹50,000, and Multi-Day Programs starting at ₹100,000. Sub-services include User-Centered Design Sessions (₹15,000/session), Problem-Solving Workshops (₹20,000/session), and Innovation Strategy Sprints (₹50,000/program).

questions.question: What's included in IT Management Solutions?
questions.answer: Our Comprehensive IT Management Solutions include Cloud Infrastructure (₹50,000/month), Cybersecurity (₹30,000/month), IT Support & Training (₹10,000/month), Digital Platform Enablement (₹50,000/project), Vendor Management (₹25,000/month), and Custom AI Model Development (₹100,000/project). We also offer project-based options: AI Server setup (₹300,000), Full Office IT setup for 10 systems + 1 server (₹300,000), and On-Premise Cloud Infrastructure (₹150,000).

questions.question: What custom bundles do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer five custom bundles: Digital Presence Bundle (₹30,000 one-time) includes a static website, 100 social media posts, 2 short videos, and basic SEO setup. Brand Launch Kit (₹75,000 one-time) includes logo, brand guidelines, website, social media setup, 50 posts, 1 brand video, and email templates. SEO Accelerator (₹40,000 one-time) is a comprehensive SEO audit and optimization sprint. Social Media Sprint (₹15,000/month) provides short-term social media boost. Innovation Workshop Sprint (₹60,000 one-time) is an intensive design thinking sprint.

questions.question: Can I add video production to my plan?
questions.answer: Yes! Video production add-ons include: Short-form videos (up to 60 seconds) at ₹5,000 per video, Brand videos (2-3 minutes) at ₹15,000 per video, and Animated explainer videos at ₹25,000 per video. These can be added to any monthly plan or purchased as standalone services.

questions.question: What content creation services are available?
questions.answer: Our content creation add-ons include: Blog posts (500-1000 words) at ₹2,000 per post, social media graphics at ₹300 per design, infographics at ₹5,000 per piece, and email newsletter design at ₹3,000 per template. These services are included in our tiered packages based on your plan level, but can also be purchased separately.

questions.question: What are your payment terms?
questions.answer: Monthly plans are billed at the start of each month. Yearly plans are billed annually upfront with a 2-month discount. One-time services and custom bundles require 50% upfront with the remainder upon completion. All prices are in INR and exclude GST. We accept bank transfers, UPI, and major credit cards.

questions.question: Is there a minimum contract period?
questions.answer: Monthly retainer plans have no minimum contract period—you can cancel anytime with 30 days notice. However, we recommend a 3-6 month commitment for optimal results, especially for SEO and social media services. Custom bundles and project-based services are one-time engagements with defined timelines.

questions.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
questions.answer: Yes! You can upgrade your plan at any time, and we'll prorate the difference. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle. Contact your account manager or our support team to discuss plan changes that align with your evolving business needs.

questions.question: Are there any hidden fees or setup costs?
questions.answer: No hidden fees. All pricing is transparent and clearly outlined in your service agreement. Domain registration and hosting fees are included in your plan. Third-party costs (ad spend, premium plugins, stock images) are billed separately at cost. Print packages include design but exclude delivery charges.

questions.question: How do I choose the right plan for my business?
questions.answer: Choose Nano if you're just starting out and need basic branding. Choose Starter for small businesses needing consistent digital presence. Choose Growth for mid-market businesses ready to scale with advanced marketing. Choose Enterprise for full-stack digital partnership with comprehensive services. Not sure? Book a free consultation and we'll recommend the best fit.

questions.question: What's the onboarding process like?
questions.answer: After signing up, we schedule a kickoff call to understand your goals. For monthly plans, you'll complete a brand questionnaire and provide any existing assets. We'll set up your website, social media accounts, and begin content creation within 1-2 weeks. Monthly deliverables start flowing from week 3 onwards with regular check-ins and reports.

questions.question: Do you work with clients outside Bharat (India)?
questions.answer: Yes! We work with clients globally. However, print packages (brand stationery with physical delivery) are currently available in Bharat only and do not include delivery charges. All digital services (website, SEO, social media, content, consulting) are available worldwide.

questions.question: Can I get a custom quote for unique requirements?
questions.answer: Absolutely. All our pricing is indicative and can be customized based on your specific needs, scope, and timeline. We offer bespoke packages for enterprises with unique requirements. Contact us for a free consultation and we'll create a tailored proposal that aligns with your goals and budget.
